title: Source-fixed crossed-lattice defect extension
research_question: Does the actual ordered eight-channel CAR cocycle admit a full odd-field defect extension whose fixed half-lattice generator, fixed permutation lift, fixed quarter clock, fixed state restriction, and fixed W4 action satisfy one common set of exact relations?
not_claimed: P1/P2 selection of the eight-channel source
selection of a Hamiltonian, beta, state, event law, probe, or instrument
ordinary-local inclusion of odd CAR fields in the bosonic E8 vacuum algebra
a raw Xi map from the original source to V16
T1-T8 closure or a physical spacetime theory

definitions.permutation_lift: P_hat E_n P_hat^-1=eta(n) E_(P n), eta(n)=(-1)^(A(n)B(n)), A=sum_{j<4}n_j, B=sum_{j>=4}n_j
definitions.torus_lift: Z_a E_n Z_a^-1=(-1)^(a dot n) E_n and Z_a X Z_a^-1=(-1)^(a dot s)X=X
definitions.normal_form: Every word reduces to a unique formal pair (n,c), written E_n X^c with n in Z^8 and c in {0,1}.
definitions.operators: U_s:=i^(-zeta_exp)X; R_c:=Z_a E_r0 P_hat; W4:=Z_a E_a P_hat. In the calibrated zeta_exp=2 gauge this is U_s=-X.

time.charges: p=n+c*s, n in Z^8, c in {0,1}
time.selection_status: premise; extending the same quadratic K_alpha to the half-lattice is tested, not derived from P1/P2

state.restriction: the fixed source CAR state omega0
state.sector_labels: [0,s,v,c]=[(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)] where the pair is (X-grade c, Q(n) mod 2) for E_n X^c
state.sector_actions: X toggles 0<->s and v<->c; every odd E_ej toggles 0<->v and s<->c
state.conditional_expectation: E0(E_n X^c)=E_n for c=0 and 0 for c=1
state.uniqueness_scope: canonical and unique only in the dual-Z2-invariant class with the stated restriction
state.positivity_scope: algebraic finite-word SOS; no C-star completion, Gibbs choice, or physical source-selection claim

chi_exp.description: lambda_j with X E_ej X^-1=i^(lambda_j) E_ej, in basis order e0..e7

kappa_exp.description: k with P_hat X P_hat^-1=i^k X

candidate_semantics.phase_convention: exponent e denotes i^e; every congruence is modulo 4
forbidden_candidate_fields: state weights, beta, density matrix, or Gram target
W4, U_s, R_c, P_hat, epsilon_Z, eta, Z_a, or their target actions
a declaration that odd fields are ordinary local

exact_constraints.formula: L(n+m)=L(n)+L(m) for all n,m in Z^8
exact_constraints.finite_reduction: definition of L from the eight generator exponents

exact_constraints.meaning: chi(n)^2=(-1)^Q(n)=eps(q,n)/eps(n,q), so conjugation by X^2 agrees with Ad(E_q) on every integer word
X commutes with E_q, hence the relation X^2=i^z E_q is associative

exact_constraints.formula: chi_exp[i]-chi_exp[j]=0 and chi_exp[i]+chi_exp[j]=2 mod 4 for every i<j
exact_constraints.meaning: for every d with even Q(d), chi(d)=(-1)^(Q(d)/2), the exact section-21 even-sector action

exact_constraints.formula: chi_exp[j]=chi_exp[(j+4) mod 8] for all j and 2*kappa_exp=0 mod 4
exact_constraints.meaning: P preserves chi and P_hat^2 acts trivially on X

exact_constraints.derivation: eps(-b,q)=+1, hence X E_r0=i^(L(-b)+zeta_exp)E_a; the source-normalized definition U_s=i^(-zeta_exp)X cancels the section phase, so with R_c=Z_a E_r0 P_hat and [Z_a,X]=0 this is exactly U_s R_c=W4. The scalar is determined by X^2 and is not a fit parameter.

exact_constraints.formula: chi_exp[j] is odd for every j
exact_constraints.meaning: X has mutual phase +i or -i with each odd CAR generator; ordinary locality is rejected. Both uniform orientations remain admissible unless an independent fixed source identity distinguishes them.

exact_constraints.formula: reduce both parenthesizations of (E_n X^c)(E_m X^d)(E_l X^f), c,d,f in {0,1}, using the fixed normal form and require identical integer charge, grade, and mu4 exponent
exact_constraints.quantification: symbolic in n,m,l; the certificate proves the polynomial exponent identities, not a finite charge sample

exact_constraints.formula: Q(U_s R_c)-Q(input)=4, Pi W_n Pi=(-1)^n W_n, and W4 is even while X is a defect-sector transporter
exact_constraints.meaning: R_c alone is never accepted as W4

exact_constraints.formula: evaluate the fixed K_alpha on n+c*s and prove the W4 Ward identity plus the two fixed mu8 quarter characters for alpha=1/4,3/4
exact_constraints.meaning: candidate phases cannot redefine time or erase the quarter phase

exact_constraints.formula: for y=a0+a1 X, E0(y* y)=a0* a0+phi^(-1)(a1* a1), where phi(E_n)=chi(n)E_n
exact_constraints.meaning: omega0 o E0 is positive on finite words whenever omega0 is positive; no new kernel is optimized

exact_constraints.formula: track (c,Q(n) mod 2) through every normal-form product and through X, odd E_ej, P_hat, U_s, R_c, and W4; require the fixed [0,s,v,c] action, T signs, and Arf recombination coefficients to be unchanged
exact_constraints.meaning: the candidate acts on all four state sectors and may not silently drop or flip the twisted-sector contribution

canonicalization.x_rephasing: Let t=exp(pi*i*g/4). Under X' = t X, zeta_exp' = zeta_exp+g mod 4, E_r0' = t E_r0, and therefore R_c' = t R_c. The normalized U_s'=i^(-zeta_exp')X' equals t^(-1)U_s, so U_s'R_c'=U_sR_c=W4. chi_exp and kappa_exp are unchanged. Canonical search representatives use zeta_exp=0; zeta is a section gauge and never a distinct algebraic candidate class.
canonicalization.permutation: no channel permutation quotient; channel order and P are source-marked

expected.interpretation: X E_n X^-1=(-i)^Q(n)E_n, X^2=-E_q, P_hat X P_hat^-1=-X
expected.status: nonempty plumbing calibration and explicit conditional construction; neither this orientation nor this P-lift branch is selected by P1/P2

first_search_objective.name: classify_full_marked_odd_defect_lifts
first_search_objective.question: Classify every source-marked mu4 crossed extension satisfying C1-C12, test whether any already-fixed source identity distinguishes chi=-i from chi=+i, and keep the two P-lift branches distinct unless a fixed source identity removes one. The currently cited source identities distinguish neither pair: both chi orientations have the same chi^2=(-1)^Q, D8 restriction, W4 Ward/quarter character, charge/parity, S/T/Arf data, and induced-state restriction; both kappa branches have the same integer-CAR P lift and W4 product, while kappa appears only when P_hat crosses X. Therefore the four survivors are algebraic candidate classes, not proven physically inequivalent classes.
first_search_objective.constructive_success: an exact candidate and Lean certificate for the full normal-form algebra, odd defect statistics, U_s R_c=W4, fixed time/quarter action, and induced-state SOS
first_search_objective.scoped_negative: an exact proof that no genotype in this crossed-extension class satisfies all fixed source identities; this excludes only this declared class
first_search_objective.stop_condition: all 4^9 canonical-zeta rows are classified (odd kappa rows serve as P-square negatives), and all four surviving orientation-by-kappa classes have an exact analytical classification and Lean certificate; stop rather than extending an already classified finite table
first_search_objective.novelty_rule: the known calibration alone is not counted as a new discovery; progress requires the all-word odd-sector extension and its fixed marking/time/state checks, or a scoped exact obstruction

gpu_evaluator.device_rule: all batch residual tensors are allocated and evaluated on the requested CUDA device; device name, UUID, dtype, batch size, synchronized elapsed time, and peak allocation are recorded
gpu_evaluator.arithmetic: torch integer tensors with exact modulo-4 residuals; the implemented fixed rational time identities are scaled by 64 (energy64), with delta represented at denominator 32 and doubled charges. The exhaustive implementation evaluates 4^9=262144 canonical-zeta rows with kappa_exp in {0,1,2,3}; P_hat^2 rejects odd kappa, leaving the 4^8*2=131072 source-valid rows before the other constraints.
